request.query: Equal diagonal Hasse derivative remainders modulo an integer polynomial imply Hasse derivative of the difference vanishes at a root

items.name: Polynomial.mod_eq_of_dvd_sub
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Field R] {p₁ p₂ q : Polynomial R}, q ∣ p₁ - p₂ → p₁ % q = p₂ % q

items.name: Polynomial.aeval_iterate_derivative_of_lt
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_3} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (p : Polynomial R)
  (q : ℕ) (r : A) {p' : Polynomial A},
  Polynomial.map (algebraMap R A) p = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r) ^ q * p' →
    ∀ {k : ℕ}, k < q → (Polynomial.aeval r) ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] p) = 0

items.name: Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_of_dvd_sub
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {p₁ p₂ q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → q ∣ p₁ - p₂ → p₁ %ₘ q = p₂ %ₘ q

items.name: Polynomial.isRoot_of_isRoot_of_dvd_derivative_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [CharZero R] {f g : Polynomial R},
  f ≠ 0 → f ∣ Polynomial.derivative f * g → ∀ {a : R}, f.IsRoot a → g.IsRoot a

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.X_sub_C_dvd_derivative_of_X_sub_C_dvd_divByMonic
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (f : Polynomial K) {a : K},
  Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∣ f /ₘ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) →
    Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∣ Polynomial.derivative f
